talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.0: Morning, %s! Big day? You look like you could carry the whole cart.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.1: %s! Good to see you. Mind the doorframe this time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.2: Ah, an orc who smiles. Don't tell the others, they'll never believe me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.3: %s, you still owe me that arm-wrestle. I've been practising.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.4: Folk talk, but you've never given me trouble, %s. That's more than I can say for my cousin.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.5: If the wolves come again, I'm standing behind you, %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.6: Heh. Strong as an ox and twice as polite. Good day, %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.7: Hungry, %s? There's stew on. You're welcome to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.8: An orc in town and no one's screaming. We're getting somewhere.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.friendly.9: Stay a while, %s. The children like your tusks.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Oh! Big %s! Hello, hello, me friend, yes? Me always friend.
Me carry your bag, %s? Me good carrier. Me no drop it. Much.
Big one is nice today. Goblin very lucky. Hee.
%s! You want shiny? Me find you shiny. For free. Nearly free.
Orc and goblin, best friends, yes? Me say so. Everybody hear.
You not squish me, %s, me not squish you. Fair. Very fair.
Strong big one! Me tell everybody you is da best orc.
Me bow, see? Little bow. For da big %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.0: An orc. Keep your hands where I can see them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.1: I've got my eye on you, %s. One wrong move.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.2: Don't come any closer. I know what your kind did at the river farms.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.3: Mother always said: lock the door when the tusks come to town.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.4: What's an orc doing here? Who let it through the gate?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.5: Smells like a war camp just walked in. Move along, %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.6: Go back to your tribe, %s. Nobody wants you here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.7: Watch your purse. Watch your daughters. An orc's about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.8: I'll fetch the guard if you so much as growl, %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.wary.9: Big and green and trouble. Don't you look at me like that.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Ugh. Orc. Me go dis way now. Very fast.
Big stupid %s, you stay over dere. Me watching. From far.
Orcs is all fist and no brain. Me hide da shinies.
Don't you look at me, %s. Me know orc. Orc squish.
Smell dat? Dat is orc. Everybody hold nose.
Me remember what orcs do to goblins. Me never forget. Never.
Go back to camp, tusky. Nobody want you here.
Me not afraid of you, %s. Me just standing behind dis wall. For reasons.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.0: Orc! To arms! Bring it down!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.1: For the town! Drive the brute back!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.2: Hit it again, it's only big, not clever!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.4: Get its legs! Bring the beast to its knees!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.5: Hold the line! It's just one orc!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.7: Back to the muck you crawled from!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.8: Help! The orc's gone mad! Help!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orc_seen.fight.9: Mind the axe! Mind the axe!
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.talk.jaymo: Stab da big one! Stab da knees! Knees is low!
Aaah! Orc! Everybody run, me mean fight!
Me get you, %s! From behind! Where you no look!
Pointy bits! Use da pointy bits on him!
Big ones fall hard! Push! PUSH!
Not da face! Not da face! ...Me face, not your face!
Dis for every goblin you ever squish, %s!
Bite his ankle! Ankles is weak!
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.102: Folk have something to say when an orc walks by. A friendly greeting, a muttered warning or a battle cry tells you how a town feels about the orcs among them.
